critical_code_review_comments: meta_compat.py connect_bank_to_meta uses m.update(e) then overwrites approval_status with title-case ('Approved'/'Rejected'/''), which is fine, but 'disbursed'/'login_done' are set as 'Yes'/'No'/'' Title case in meta mirror while the Connect eligibility row (returned by meta_bank_to_connect) uses lowercase 'yes'/'no'. Round-trip on GET after PUT will return the lowercase (from meta_bank_to_connect reading _pick 'disbursed' from meta, which is now 'Yes' -> _yn returns 'yes'). No user-visible bug; noting for clarity.

meta_compat.py permission gate for POST /notes and DELETE /documents uses _perm can_info which for growth_partner=True. This means GPs can add notes and delete documents on their own files - spec text only restricts bank/status writes for GP so this is correct.
Users.js: the pencil Edit button did not have a data-testid; I added data-testid={`edit-role-${user.account_key || user.id}`} to make the flow selectable for automation.
